notes.finding: Allocator descriptor accessor/init; flags API masks LOOP|NO_UPDATE. SetFObj tears down old chain before replacement, with no alias guard. Callback counters reset independently of callback list. Request restarts; Stop delegates then sets NO_ANIM.

First call does not advance; valid loop flushes and requests modulo frame, invalid interval clamps and does not request. NO_UPDATE supplies null only for main FObj interpretation; stop callbacks remain live. Counters count eligible calls, not unique objects.
Descriptor loader preserves stopped allocation state and filters descriptor flags. Nonzero obj_id retains table object or loads JObj. Removal drops FObj list and JObj reference before own free.

Twelve callback formats; float variadic payload reads f64 then narrows. Parent category mask does not prune descendants. PObj helper processes a single shape set. JObj processes descendants but not root next; INSTANCE suppresses child traversal only.
Scalar setters null guard, no finite/range validation. SetCurrentFrame ignores stopped objects; ForgetMemory unconditionally clears callback head, ignores range, preserves counters.
Exact public structs, enum callback order, bit26..30 flags and two assertion-based inline frame getters. C renderer11 parse errors, H0; no substitutions.

foreign_canonical_support.finding: Allocator nullable paths, free list/counter writes, init unlink/reset/default size alignment verified.
Object init includes AObj/FObj; stats table uses both accessors.
JObj hierarchy animation resets/invokes completion counters; joint loader delegates creation/ref resolution.
fmodf inline divides and converts quotient to signed long long, then subtracts product; finite/range limitations apply.
